AdvanceThread.description: Move a storyline the scenario is tracking: where it stands now, or that it is over.

thread_id.description: Exact id of one thread in ACTIVE THREADS.
thread_id.title: Thread Id

status.description: Where the thread now stands, or null to leave it as it is.
status.title: Status

stage.description: Stable slug for the point it has reached, or null to leave it as it is.
stage.title: Stage

tick.description: How many segments this fills on the thread's clock, when it has one.
tick.title: Tick

AdvanceThread.title: AdvanceThread

Attempt.description: One risky attempt, answered by the highest die of a pool.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor attempting this: the player, or an actor here.
actor_id.title: Actor Id

goal.description: What the actor is trying to do and what they risk by trying, in one line.
goal.title: Goal

skill.description: The skill on the actor's sheet this calls on, copied exactly as it is written there. Empty when none of theirs applies: they roll the bare d6.
skill.title: Skill

helped.description: The circumstance that makes this easier — a skill, a piece of gear, the ground they hold, an ally's presence — in a few words. Empty when nothing does.
helped.title: Helped

helper_id.description: Exact id of an ally here who helps with this — they roll their own skill die into the pool. Null when nobody helps.
helper_id.title: Helper Id

helper_skill.description: The skill on the *helper's* sheet this calls on, copied exactly as it is written there. Empty when none of theirs applies: they roll the bare d6.
helper_skill.title: Helper Skill

hindered.description: The circumstance that makes this harder, in a few words. Empty when nothing does.
hindered.title: Hindered

luck_test.description: What bad luck might arrive alongside this — running out of ammo, running into guards. The engine rolls whether it does. Empty for no test.
luck_test.title: Luck Test

Attempt.title: Attempt

ChangeCredits.description:
Move an actor's credits for gear bought, repairs paid, debts collected or pay earned —
never for a roll's own outcome, which the engine settles itself.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor: the player, or an actor here.
actor_id.title: Actor Id

amount.description: Positive to pay them, negative to charge them. A charge the pool cannot cover is refused.
amount.title: Amount

ChangeCredits.title: ChangeCredits

CompleteJob.description:
Record that the job is done — the fiction's own boundary, written once when the crew's
engagement genuinely closes, usually alongside resolving its thread. Never for a mere scene
ending.
CompleteJob.title: CompleteJob

GainImprovisedItem.description:
Give the player an ordinary incidental object that is not in canon and is not worth a canon
entry of its own. Never a substitute for an item that already exists.

item_name.description: The object written out, such as 'a handful of gravel'.
item_name.title: Item Name

GainImprovisedItem.title: GainImprovisedItem

LuckTest.description: The SRD's standalone bad-luck test, for a beat where nothing is attempted.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor whose luck is tested: the player, or an actor here.
actor_id.title: Actor Id

subject.description: What bad luck might arrive — running out of ammo, running into guards. The engine rolls whether it does.
subject.title: Subject

LuckTest.title: LuckTest

Move.description:
Move an actor who actually changes location, or one item within the player's reach: picked
up, set down here, or handed to an actor here. Moving the player to an unrevealed location
reveals it.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the actor or item that moves; `player` is the played character. An item must be one the player carries, or one loose at their location.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

to_id.description: Exact id of where it goes: for an actor the location they enter; for an item, `player` to pick it up, an actor here with the player to hand it over, or the player's own location to set it down.
to_id.title: To Id

Move.title: Move

RelationChange.description:
Record, break, unblock, or reveal a lasting tie between two entities. Containment is not a
tie: carrying an item or standing somewhere are moves. `reveal` shows the player a way through
they did not know about; write it before moving them through a passage they have not found.
`unlock` opens a locked way when the fiction opens it.

mode.description: What happens to the tie: `add` records it, `remove` breaks it, `unlock` opens a way that was locked, `reveal` shows it to the player.
mode.title: Mode

kind.description: What the tie is: `connected` joins two locations the player can walk between, `party-member` puts an actor here into the player's party (source is the actor, target is `player`).
kind.title: Kind

source.description: Exact id of the tie's source entity.
source.title: Source

target.description: Exact id of the tie's target entity.
target.title: Target

RelationChange.title: RelationChange

Reveal.description:
Reveal an entity that exists but the player does not know yet: they notice it, are told of
it, or reach it. Prefer this over inventing a replacement.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the unrevealed canon entity.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

Reveal.title: Reveal

TraitChange.description:
Put a lasting condition, skill, or frailty on an entity, or lift one the fiction ends. The
trait shows the id written out: `battle-worn` appears as Battle Worn.

mode.description: `add` puts the trait on, `remove` lifts one the entity carries.
mode.title: Mode

entity_id.description: Exact id of the entity affected; an actor must be here with the player.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

trait_id.description: Stable slug for the trait, such as `poisoned`; to remove, the exact id of a trait the entity carries.
trait_id.title: Trait Id

text.description: The constraint or benefit it puts on the entity, in prose. Adding only.
text.title: Text

TraitChange.title: TraitChange

description: One thing put to the dice and what it causes. A turn is one beat, or several when what the dice settled asks for another.

roll.description: The one thing this beat puts to the dice, or null when nothing that happens is uncertain enough to roll.

effects.description: What this beat causes in the world, applied once the roll has settled. Empty when nothing changes.
effects.title: Effects

title: TwentyfourxxBeat
